name: Supreme Court of Kenya
jurisdiction: Final appellate court; presidential election petitions; advisory opinions for national government.

name: Court of Appeal
jurisdiction: Appeals from High Court and superior courts with appellate jurisdiction.

name: High Court of Kenya
jurisdiction: Unlimited original civil and criminal jurisdiction; constitutional petitions; judicial review; appeals from subordinate courts.

name: Environment and Land Court
jurisdiction: Land, environment, planning and property disputes; appeals from tribunals on land and environment.

name: Employment and Labour Relations Court
jurisdiction: Employment, labour relations, and related disputes including unfair termination and trade disputes.

name: Chief Magistrates' Courts
jurisdiction: Civil and criminal matters within pecuniary and statutory limits; committals to High Court.

name: Kadhi's Courts
jurisdiction: Muslim personal status, marriage, divorce or inheritance where all parties profess Islam and consent.

name: Court Martial
jurisdiction: Discipline and offences under the Kenya Defence Forces Act.

name: National Environment Tribunal
jurisdiction: Appeals from NEMA decisions, EIA licences, improvement and prohibition orders under EMCA.

name: National Land Commission
jurisdiction: Historical land injustices, compulsory acquisition recommendations, public land management advice.

name: Tax Appeals Tribunal
jurisdiction: Appeals against KRA assessments and decisions under tax statutes.

name: Co-operative Tribunal
jurisdiction: Disputes arising from the operation of co-operative societies under Cap. 490.

name: Public Procurement Administrative Review Board
jurisdiction: Challenges to procurement and award decisions under PPADA 2015.

name: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman)
jurisdiction: Maladministration, delay, injustice and abuse of power by public officers; access to information enforcement.

name: Independent Policing Oversight Authority
jurisdiction: Oversight of police conduct; complaints and investigations of police offences.
